dotnet.label: .NET
dotnet.note: bin/obj are only treated as build output when a project/solution file sits next to them. Prevents matching hand-written bin/ folders (Rails, npm CLI scripts, etc).

go.label: Go
go.note: Only matches bin/ when go.mod is a sibling. Go build caches live outside the repo (GOCACHE) and are not covered here.

playwright.label: Playwright
playwright.note: Only matches when a playwright.config.* file sits next to the folder, so unrelated test-results/ folders are left alone. A custom outputDir can be added with a rules file.

playwright-mcp.label: Playwright MCP
playwright-mcp.note: Screenshots, page snapshots and logs written by the Playwright MCP server during browser sessions. Always regenerated.

cloudflare.label: Cloudflare Wrangler
cloudflare.note: Wrangler's local folder. Besides build temp files it can hold local D1, KV, R2 and Durable Object data persisted by `wrangler dev`, so it is opt-in. Enable with --risky.

misc.label: Misc (ambiguous names, opt-in)
misc.note: These names are also used for intentionally committed content in some projects. Enable with --risky; to scan only this group, use --only misc --risky.
